blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Supreme Court has ruled that Congress has a constitutional duty to craft and pass a law prohibiting political dynasties, noting that its continued inaction over the past 39 years amounts to a continuing violation. Camille Ting, the high tribunal’s spokesperson, announced the en banc’s unanimous ruling on the consolidated petitions for certiorari and mandamus filed by various groups that urged the Supreme Court to compel the Congress to enact a law that defines and bans political dynasties.
